# `pyrite` deprecations

Version: `0.36.0`

<!-- Generated by `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`; do not edit by hand. -->

Per [ADR-0002](../../adr/0002-cli-surface-redesign.md), every renamed or retired `pyrite` command or option keeps its old spelling working for a minimum of 2 minor releases, warns on stderr naming the replacement, and is listed here with its removal target. See the [CLI reference](cli-reference.md) for the current command surface; regenerate this table with `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`.

## Commands

No command spelling is currently deprecated. Every spelling the CLI accepts is canonical; anything else exits as an unknown command, except hard-break removals without a support window (`numerics precision`, #1007), which exit as usage errors naming their replacement.

## Argument forms

These spellings reach a current command with a deprecated argument shape; they still run, warn on stderr and keep their exit codes.

| Deprecated form | Replacement | Deprecated in | Remove in | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pyrite profile physics set PROFILE --OPTION off` | `--OPTION none` | 0.36.0 | 0.38.0 | also `physics create` and `physics set`; options `--channeling-model`, `--transition-radiation`, `--pair-production-model`, `--secondary-threshold-ev` |

## Implicit defaults

No implicit default is currently deprecated. A run that leaves its profile unnamed, or a user-catalog profile that names no beam or detector, exits as a usage error.
